methods.implementation: Own cyclic prefix-doubling BWT over complete uint16 alphabets, primary position per 65536 symbols; Fenwick move-to-front, full inverse; existing A1 arithmetic ranks. Not a bzip2 stream.

Reviewed integer/lapped lifting options; do not substitute JPEG-XR PCT or a rounded approximate integer DCT for the declared transforms. Own N=8 orthonormal DCT-II and DST-I definitions, serialized Q20 basis and coefficients, exact whole-codeword corrections from actual integer inverse. Not FFTW-linked codecs or native reversible integer DCT/DST.

Own definition-based MDCT, 2N=16 hop8, sine window satisfying Princen-Bradley, zero-prefix priming and suffix within each independent component. Serialize Q20 cosine/window and coefficients; IMDCT 2/N and overlap-add before exact codeword correction. No Vorbis framing; window differs from Vorbis nested-sine window.

Two distinct exact transforms: whole-sample symmetric reversible CDF 5/3 prediction/update with floor division; Haar S transform d=b-a,s=a+floor(d/2). Multilevel 256-word blocks, odd tails explicitly handled, signed int64 intermediate and checked int32 coefficients, no lossy clipping or correction stream.

Only this D plugin performs MSB-first full-codeword bit-plane mapping; every plane arithmetic-coded with its own static binary model, all model/state bytes billed; restore native codewords and packed byte order.
Prefix <=512 eight-dimensional vectors, centered covariance, full ordered eigenbasis. Save mean/basis Q20 and all coefficients, exact codeword XOR corrections. Decode does not recompute eigenvectors.

Actual OMP with orthogonal least-squares support refit, sparsity3, eight-dimensional 16-atom identity+DCT dictionary. K-SVD initializes from normalized samples and alternates OMP and supported residual rank-1 SVD updates four rounds (<=512 training vectors), reinitializes unused atoms with current residuals; final serialized dictionary used for all coding. Sparse supports, Q20 coefficients, dictionary and exact corrections billed. Not k-means.

One shared explicit rank-2 truncated-SVD configuration over C-order contiguous64-value 8x8 tiles. Save two Q20 square-root-scaled factors and codeword correction; no singular spectrum statistics-only proxy.

C-order contiguous64-value 4x4x4 tensors, T[i,j,k]=stream[base+16i+4j+k]. CP rank2, twenty ALS sweeps with Khatri-Rao designs, minimum-norm SVD solves and scale normalization. Tucker HOSVD separate mode unfoldings, ranks(2,2,2), three4x2 factors plus2x2x2 core. Each has its own reconstruction, all factors/cores Q20 and exact correction.
TT-SVD successive reshape/SVD on 4x4x4 C-order tiles, ranks(1,2,2,1). Cores1x4x2,2x4x2,2x4x1; final serialized integer contraction and exact correction; not a CP/Tucker or matrix-SVD alias.
Nearest2x2 tensor4x4 Kronecker product per8x8 tile: explicit4x16 rearrangement, leading SVD and square-root-scaled factors. Own integer inverse rearrangement/contraction and codeword correction.
Least-squares circulant fit via means along cyclic diagonals, C[i,j]=c[(j-i) mod8]. Eight Q20 generator parameters and exact correction for arbitrary input, not pre-filtering exact circulants.

methods.dependencies: Existing A1/YAECL arithmetic and C3 numerical interpretation/fixed-value projection, Eigen 3.3.7 cf794d3b741a6278df169e58461f8529f43bce5d. No duplicate library copy; all dependency hashes verified by D build metadata.
methods.implementation: Parameters explicitly serialized, coefficient/factor values zigzag int32 then interleaved low/high uint16 words through same A1 arithmetic. Codeword XOR correction separate. Decoder uses bounded __int128 fixed-point contractions; no floating decomposition/learning on decode.
